verdict.rationale: Codex cloud lets you start a task from the web, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Slack, or the CLI, then return later from another surface. The `codex cloud` command browses active and completed cloud chats, can request follow-ups, and applies results to a local repo, so a task started in one place can be continued elsewhere. Missing for 10: cross-device continuation of local CLI sessions (`codex resume` only searches local chats), explicit documentation of session sync between the desktop app, IDE and web, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the cross-device workflow.
